threshold_policy.maximum_price: No universal maximum is assumed by default. A deployment may configure one with documented market and currency evidence.
threshold_policy.return_outlier_abs: A 50% absolute adjusted daily return is a review trigger (CONDITIONAL), not proof that the value is wrong.
threshold_policy.adjustment_factor_jump_abs: A 20% adjustment-factor change without supplied corporate-action evidence is a review trigger (CONDITIONAL), not an automatic repair instruction.

status_policy.PASS: No schema/key/missing/duplicate/blocking/conditional findings and a verified trading calendar was supplied.
status_policy.CONDITIONAL: No blocking finding, but the calendar is unverified or a configured review threshold/corporate-action check needs evidence.
status_policy.BLOCKED: A required schema/key/cell, confirmed trading date, duplicate, non-positive price, negative volume, OHLC, or repair-audit rule failed.
